answer_1.quote: For long-form output tasks, we employ FACTSCORE to evaluate factuality in biography generation and CS4 to assess constrained creative story generation.

answer_2.quote: we use GPT-4o to evaluate constraint satisfaction , computed per story as 100 × # of satisfied constraints # of total constraints . We use BooookScore to evaluate coherence and internal consistency of the generated stories.

answer_3.quote: employing GPT4o as the judge... GPT4o is also used to evaluate story quality using BooookScore.

answer_4.quote: The 42 story-constraint pairs were manually annotated by one of the authors, who independently read each story and assessed which constraints were satisfied.
